arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 100 python3 -u -c "
import sys, time, json, subprocess, os
ENV = dict(os.environ); ENV['PYTHONPATH']='/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission'; ENV['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']='/workspace/native'
for seed in range(4):
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=open('/tmp/r%d.json'%seed,'rb').read(), capture_output=True, env=ENV, timeout=20)
    print(seed, 'run', round(time.time()-t0,2), p.returncode, len(p.stdout), flush=True)
    open('/tmp/o%d.json'%seed,'wb').write(p.stdout)
" 2>&1 | tail -10
